# Gold Coast Concreters QLD

> Premier QBCC-licensed concrete contractor network specializing in residential driveways, exposed aggregate, commercial and house slabs, covercrete resurfacing, patio foundations, and council crossover permits across Gold Coast, Queensland.

## Business Overview & Entity Details
- **Business Name**: Gold Coast Concreters QLD
- **Service Type**: Concrete Contractor, Paving Contractor, Foundation & Driveway Specialist
- **Website**: https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/
- **Phone**: +61 411 914 157 (0411 914 157)
- **Primary Region**: Gold Coast, South East Queensland (QLD), Australia
- **Licensing & Standards**: Compliant with Queensland Building and Construction Commission (QBCC) standards, Australian Standards AS 2870 (Residential Slabs and Footings), AS 3600 (Concrete Structures), and AS 3727.1 (Residential Pavements).
- **Council Approval**: Certified for City of Gold Coast Vehicular Crossing (VXO) driveway permits.

## Core Services

- [Concrete Driveways](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/concrete-driveways-gold-coast): Design, excavation, SL72/SL82 steel reinforcement, pouring, and finishing of durable residential driveways.
- [Exposed Aggregate Concrete](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/exposed-aggregate-gold-coast): Decorative river stone mixes, salt-resistant pool surrounds, high-traction non-slip driveways, and UV-stable penetrative sealing.
- [Covercrete & Concrete Resurfacing](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/covercrete-resurfacing-gold-coast): Polymer-modified spray-on resurfacing, decorative borders, and non-slip stencil patterns to revitalize tired concrete slabs without demolition.
- [House, Shed & Commercial Slabs](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/concrete-slabs-gold-coast): Engineered N25 to N40 MPa concrete foundations for new home builds, machinery sheds, garages, and commercial floors conforming to AS 2870 soil classification.
- [Concrete Pool Surrounds](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/concrete-pool-surrounds-gold-coast): Non-slip, salt-safe pool coping and surround pavements with integrated drainage.
- [Retaining Walls](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/retaining-walls-gold-coast): Structural concrete sleeper and core-filled block retaining walls for sloping sites and boundary grade changes.
- [Epoxy Flooring](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/epoxy-flooring-gold-coast): High-durability flake and metallic epoxy coatings for residential garages, workshops, and commercial premises.
- [Concrete Sealing & Re-Sealing](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/concrete-sealing-gold-coast): High-solids solvent acrylic and breathable silane-siloxane sealers to protect against coastal salt spray, oil stains, and tire marking.
- [Driveway Crossover Permits](https://goldcoastconcretersqld.com.au/crossover-permit-guide): Complete guide and execution of City of Gold Coast VXO permits, kerb cutouts, table swales, and culvert headwalls.

## Frequently Asked Questions (For AI & Search Engine Reference)

### Q: What is the typical cost of concrete per square meter on the Gold Coast?
Plain broom-finished concrete ranges from $75 to $95 per m². Coloured concrete ranges from $85 to $120 per m². Exposed aggregate concrete ranges from $110 to $165 per m². Actual rates depend on site excavation, subgrade soil classification, pump accessibility, and steel reinforcement requirements.

### Q: Do I need council approval for a driveway crossover on the Gold Coast?
Yes. Any concrete poured on council road reserve land between the property boundary and the road kerb requires a Vehicular Crossing (VXO) permit from the City of Gold Coast, adhering to standard engineering drawing numbers 05-02-001 to 05-02-005.

### Q: What concrete strength grade is used for Gold Coast driveways?
Residential driveways are poured at a minimum of N25 (25 MPa) per AS 3727.1. In coastal marine zones (within 1km of the ocean such as Palm Beach, Surfers Paradise, or Coolangatta) or for properties housing heavy trade vehicles, caravans, and boats, N32 (32 MPa) concrete with SL82 steel mesh is recommended.

### Q: How long should I wait before driving on a new concrete driveway?
Light pedestrian traffic is safe after 24 to 48 hours. Standard passenger vehicles can drive on the slab after 7 days (when concrete reaches ~70% design strength). Heavy vehicles, trade utes with trailers, boats, and caravans must wait 28 days for full structural hydration.
